create_ExponentialMovingAverage: create an ExponentialMovingAverage module with a decay rate and optional zero debiasing
use_ExponentialMovingAverage_call: use the ExponentialMovingAverage module to update and return an exponentially weighted average of a value
use_ExponentialMovingAverage_initialize: initialize the ExponentialMovingAverage hidden and average state to zeros of a given shape and dtype
create_EMAParamsTree: create an EMAParamsTree module to maintain exponential moving averages for all parameters in a tree
use_EMAParamsTree_call: apply EMAParamsTree to a parameter tree to return EMA decayed versions of each parameter
